t2.thesis: CHYM has a consistent beat-and-raise history with a perfect 4/4 positive post-earnings opens, rising estimates and a bullish pre-earnings analyst tone, but the 13% implied move and a fully priced stock cap the edge.
reasons: Last 4 prints all had positive open-to-open returns (+13.2%, +2.0%, +9.7%, +1.9%) with large EPS beats
EPS estimates revised up 66% over 90 days and the last quarter was a beat-and-raise with guidance raised
Peer fintechs (SoFi +13% post-earnings) reacted well this season and Evercore named CHYM a top pick
Bar is high: stock up ~66% over 12m, implied move 13% with IV 1.7x realized, and one firm calls it fairly valued
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance relative to the elevated whisper, plus Active Member and Chime Prime momentum.

prior.from: D004 base rates: overall validation hit 0.542, AMC 0.538, fintech/software-internet cluster ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. The date you mention (2026-11-04) is after today's date of 2026-11-03 and past my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information on how CHYM's stock moved after that earnings report.
t2.moved_from_prior: Up about 4 points from 0.54 for the beat/raise history, upward estimate revisions and a constructive peer tape, partly offset by the elevated expectations and a thin 4-print sample.

theses.expected: Beat with raised full-year guide; stock gaps up at the open
theses.mechanism: Chime Prime, MyPay and Instant Loans drive upside to revenue and EBITDA, and a pattern of conservative guidance continues
theses.wrong_if: Q4 guide implies deceleration below about 24% growth or EBITDA margin disappoints

theses.expected: In-line print and a sell-the-news drop
theses.mechanism: Stock is up strongly over the year, with a high implied move and a fully-priced valuation leaving little room
theses.wrong_if: Active Members and ARPAM accelerate beyond expectations

theses.expected: Muted or mixed reaction driven by the Stride Bank acquisition and the CFO transition
theses.mechanism: Investors focus on capital deployment, integration risk and finance leadership instead of the quarter itself
theses.wrong_if: Management gives clean synergy and permanent-CFO clarity that is well received

Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guide versus consensus
